currently.paragraph3: Open to remote roles in LATAM, mostly healthtech and fintech. Email me or book a call.

intro.paragraph1: Product Engineer, with four years split between deciding what gets built and building it. The most useful thing I did at Banana Software was cut roughly one in five planned features from the roadmap, because they didn't earn what they cost. The ones that stayed, I wrote myself, in Next.js and TypeScript. I live in Argentina and work remotely with teams in the US and LATAM.
intro.paragraph2: I'm a bioengineer from ITBA. My thesis predicted 2-year mortality in patients with colorectal cancer liver metastasis, using real data from Hospital Italiano de Buenos Aires, and it left me in the habit of asking a decision for a number before making it. I came into product through the frontend: I went through Techstars W24 in New York with Tumo, and later led four projects at Banana with teams of three or four people and up to 1,500 active users.
intro.paragraph3: I'm looking for teams where product, engineering and business get discussed at the same table, mostly healthtech, fintech or growing startups. If you have a specific role, email me. If it's a product you're thinking about and you want a second head on it, book a call.

tools.intro: I mostly work with Next.js, TypeScript and PostgreSQL. I've integrated payments with Stripe, Mercado Pago and PayPal, and moved product off Bubble to rewrite it in Next.js.
